Create biomass target files and calibration inputs

create_target_files_biomass.Rd

Creates biomass targets for calibrar from one of two sources:

  • initial.conditions = TRUE (default): the initial biomass of each functional group (first time step of the Atlantis <prefix>_OUTBiomIndx.txt output) is used as a constant target.

  • time.series = TRUE: the observed biomass time series of each group in biomass.file is used as the target.

Writes all the files needed to set up a biomass calibration:

  • data/<Code>_biomass.csv: one target time series per calibrated group, with columns Time and Biomass.

  • calibration_settings_biomass.csv: calibration settings for each biomass target.

  • calibration-parameters-complete.csv: parameter factors to estimate for each group, as set in parameter.file, with initial values, bounds and phase.

  • biomass.txt and biomass_crash.txt: R code snippets used to build the output list of the run model function, for a successful run and for a crashed run (all zeros), respectively.

Usage

create_target_files_biomass(
  biom.indx = NULL,
  fg.file,
  output.path = here::here("inputs"),
  not.calibrated,
  dt.timeseries = 5,
  unfished = FALSE,
  factor.unfished = 1.3,
  initial.conditions = TRUE,
  time.series = FALSE,
  biomass.file = "biomass_timeseries.csv",
  biology.prm,
  parameter.file = "parameter_table.csv",
  repro.file = "reproduction-option.csv"
)

Arguments

biom.indx

Character. Path to the Atlantis biomass index text file (<prefix>_OUTBiomIndx.txt). Required when initial.conditions = TRUE. Default: NULL.

fg.file

Character. Path to the functional groups CSV file. Must contain the columns Code, Name, IsFished and GroupType.

output.path

Character. Directory where output files are written. Target time series are written to its data sub-directory, which is created if needed. Default: inputs.

not.calibrated

Character vector. Codes of functional groups to exclude from calibration. Default: c("PS", "PL", "DC", "DL", "DR").

dt.timeseries

Integer. Number of time steps in each target time series. Default: 5.

unfished

Logical. If TRUE, create targets for an unfished scenario (see Details). Default: FALSE.

factor.unfished

Numeric. Factor applied to the initial biomass of fished groups to obtain the unfished biomass target. Only used when unfished = TRUE. Default: 1.3.

initial.conditions

Logical. If TRUE, use the initial biomass in biom.indx as a constant target. Default: TRUE.

time.series

Logical. If TRUE, use the observed biomass time series in biomass.file as the target. Exactly one of initial.conditions and time.series must be TRUE. Default: FALSE.

biomass.file

Character. Name of the observed biomass CSV file in inputs/model_configuration, with columns Code, Year and Biomass. Only used when time.series = TRUE. Default: biomass_timeseries.csv.

biology.prm

Character. Name of the Atlantis biology parameter file in inputs/model_configuration.

parameter.file

Character. Name of the parameter table CSV file in inputs, with one row per functional group and one column per parameter to calibrate (any of mum, BHalpha, BHbeta, KDENR, mfc, mQ, mL, C and E), set to 1 if the parameter is calibrated for that group. Default: "parameter_table.csv".

repro.file

Character. Name of the reproduction option CSV file in inputs, with columns Code and flagrecruit, as written by repro_option. Default: "reproduction-option.csv".

Value

Invisibly, a named list with elements settings (calibration settings data frame) and parameters (calibration parameters data frame). Called for its side effect of writing files to output.path.

Details

The parameters to calibrate, and the groups each one applies to, are read from parameter.file (see read_parameter_table). Factors are only created for groups that are turned on and calibrated. BHalpha, BHbeta and KDENR factors are only created for groups with GroupType FISH, SHARK, BIRD or MAMMAL, taken from parameter.file if it has a GroupType column, or else from fg.file. mfc factors are only created for groups with IsFished == 1 in fg.file. KDENR factors are only created for groups whose flagrecruit in repro.file is 12, and BHalpha and BHbeta factors only for groups whose flagrecruit is 3 (Beverton-Holt). Groups with other recruitment options, or missing from repro.file get none of the three.

If unfished = TRUE, targets are created for an unfished scenario instead: only fished groups (IsFished == 1) are included, and their initial biomass is multiplied by factor.unfished. Outputs are written with an _unfished suffix so they do not overwrite the standard biomass calibration files: targets go to data_unfished/, and the other files are calibration_settings_unfished.csv, calibration-parameters-unfished.csv, biomass_unfished.txt and biomass_unfished_crash.txt. mfc factors are not created in this case, as fishing is turned off.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  create_target_files_biomass(
    biom.indx = "path/to/outputs/AMPS_OUTBiomIndx.txt",
    fg.file   = "path/to/PugetSoundAtlantisFunctionalGroups_2024.csv"
  )

  # Unfished scenario
  create_target_files_biomass(
    biom.indx     = "path/to/outputs/AMPS_OUTBiomIndx.txt",
    fg.file       = "path/to/PugetSoundAtlantisFunctionalGroups_2024.csv",
    unfished      = TRUE
  )

  # Observed biomass time series as target
  create_target_files_biomass(
    fg.file            = "path/to/PugetSoundAtlantisFunctionalGroups_2024.csv",
    initial.conditions = FALSE,
    time.series        = TRUE
  )
} # }
